# Nebula Notebook

> Open-source, self-hosted Python/Jupyter notebook server with a React browser editor, a FastAPI gateway, Docker-managed CPU sessions and optional container-verified NVIDIA GPU runtimes. MIT-licensed beta for trusted environments.

Canonical project: https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook

## Documentation
- [Main README](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/README.md): introduction, features, quickstart, comparison and limitations.
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 中文项目介绍与部署。
- [Deployment](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): Ubuntu installation, CPU/GPU setup, validation and HTTPS considerations.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): document state, session, Kernel, WebSocket, security boundaries.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): direct answers about GPU, Jupyter support, hosting, sharing and security.
- [Comparison](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/docs/COMPARISON.md): Nebula vs Colab vs JupyterLab.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/mcp/README.md): 35-tool stdio MCP server for Pi, Claude, Codex and OpenCode; notebook/cell/run/workspace/admin tools, client configs and security model.
- [Security](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/SECURITY.md): beta threat model and disclosure instructions.
- [Validation](https://github.com/1998x-stack/Nebula-Notebook/blob/main/VALIDATION_REPORT.md): evidence and limitations of tests.

## Important limitations
Not affiliated with Google or Project Jupyter. No managed cloud GPU. Do not deploy v0.1 for untrusted internet users or imply VM-grade security. Runtime end-to-end execution and GPU acceptance must be verified on the target host. The MCP server reuses the same user privileges and executes Python; use a dedicated account and keep it local.
